project_info.theme: Dramatic white feather red-carpet look photographed from a low angle

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with long wavy blonde hair over her shoulders, fair glowing skin, confident expression and subtle smile. prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic full-body low-angle red-carpet portrait of a generic clearly adult woman with long wavy blonde hair cascading over her shoulders, fair glowing skin, a confident expression and a subtle smile. She wears a shimmering white sequined fashion top with a tasteful deep neckline and small bow detail, a long dramatic white skirt or train adorned with luxurious white feather trim and elegant white or metallic pointed heels. Pose her on a classic red carpet with one hand reaching dynamically toward the camera, creating a strong but non-sexual perspective. Use an extreme low-angle view from near ground level, with foreground shoes, feather train and flowing fabric visible. Set the scene against a deep maroon premiere backdrop with fictional neutral title lettering and no recognizable sponsor logos. Use professional event flash and ambient lighting, glossy highlights on sequins and feathers, high contrast, 8K photorealistic detail and sharp fabric texture. Preserve the source outfit, train, gesture, low-angle composition and premiere atmosphere without reproducing a public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, nudity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted perspective, recognizable sponsor logo, illegible text
